task.description: Diagnose ISS-0180 (GH #511): audit every check C1..C7 of tools/verify_test_env.py for dev-vs-test database confusion; reproduce the false green.
acceptance_criteria: All of C1..C7 audited for which env var they read
Defect mechanism traced to source lines

result.summary: C3 runs zig build migrate, which src/tools/migrate.zig resolves ONLY from BPM_DB_URL (dev DB), while C4/C6 and all integration tests use BPM_TEST_DB_URL. Reproduced: with dev at 108/108 and test held at 107/108, C3 PASS and C4 FAIL in the same run. Audit found a second, same-family defect in C1: it hardcodes container name r-co-db_test-1 while this workspace uses COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=r-co-2, so it falls through to a name-substring docker ps filter matching ANY project db_test. C7 is weak-by-design (mirrors bench.zig precedence, prefers dev) but never reported which DB it resolved. C2/C5 touch no DB; C4/C6 were already correct.
